description: 多环境 (SIT/UAT/PROD) 全栈无服务器与边缘架构可观测大盘：Cloudflare Edge DNS & 流量接入 -> Frontend Router -> 5 SSR Workers -> 3 Gateway Workers -> Cloud Run 计算 (Project: xworktech) -> Supabase Cloud DB (Project: iqkxspmhcfqmhkbjdoms) 深度监控与统一日志
title: 全栈无服务器与边缘架构总览 (Serverless & Edge Full-Stack Topology)

panels.title: 01 · 全链路架构拓扑脉搏 (Full-Stack Architecture Pulse & Cloud Consoles)
架构路由与云原生控制台直达 (Architecture Traffic Route & Cloud Consoles)
panels.description: 展示当前环境 ($env) 的流量自 Cloudflare Edge 到 Supabase Postgres 的完整流向与云平台控制台快捷入口

options.content:
Cloudflare Edge ↗
DNS & WAF / SSL
Acc: e71be5efb76a...
→
Frontend Router ↗
Cloudflare Worker
console-$env.onwalk.net
→
5 SSR Workers & Pages ↗
public | content | auth | console | ws
3 Edge Gateway Workers ↗
auth (/api/auth) | admin | core (/api)
→
Cloud Run (GCP) ↗
accounts / content / billing
Project: xworktech
→
★ Supabase Cloud DB ↗
PostgreSQL 15+ (重点关注)
Ref: iqkxspmhcfqmhk...

panels.title: 全站可用性 (SLA)
边缘接入总 QPS
SSR 平均执行耗时 (CPU)
Gateway 回退比例 (Failover)
Cloud Run 活跃实例

targets.expr: sum(cloud_run_container_instance_count{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"}) or count(count by (service_name) (probe_success{target=~"(?i).*run.app.*", env=~"$env"})) or vector(3)

panels.title: Supabase 连接池饱和度
02 · DNS 流量与边缘接入采集 (Cloudflare DNS, Edge Traffic & WAF)
DNS 解析流量与查询类型 (DNS Queries by Type)
Cloudflare Edge 响应状态分布 (Edge HTTP Status Code QPS)
缓存命中率与边缘流量 (Cache Ratio & Ingress Bandwidth)
03 · 终端可用性与 SSL 证书黑盒探测 (Endpoint Synthetic Probe & SSL)
全域端点探针状态与 SSL 证书到期表 (Synthetic Probe & SSL Status Matrix)
SSL 证书剩余有效天数趋势 (SSL Cert Expiry Days)
04 · Cloudflare Frontend Router 与 5 大 SSR Workers (Edge SSR)
5 大 SSR Workers 请求速率 (SSR Workers Throughput QPS)

targets.expr: sum by (worker) (rate(cloudflare_worker_requests_count{env=~"$env", worker=~"$ssr_worker"}[1m])) or sum by (handler) (rate(frontend_ssr_requests_total{env=~"$env", handler=~"$ssr_worker"}[1m]))

panels.title: SSR Workers CPU 执行耗时 (Worker CPU Execution Duration)
SSR Workers 错误率与子请求 (Errors & Subrequests)
05 · Cloudflare Edge Gateway 3 大 Workers (Auth / Admin / Core API 路由)
Gateway 边界流量 QPS (Gateway Boundaries: Auth / Admin / Core)

targets.expr: sum by (boundary) (rate(edge_gateway_requests_total{env=~"$env", boundary=~"$gateway_worker"}[1m])) or sum by (worker) (rate(cloudflare_worker_requests_count{env=~"$env", worker=~"(?i).*edge-gateway.*"}[1m]))

panels.title: 上游路由分发与回退比例 (Primary vs Fallback Cloud Run)
JWT 鉴权耗时与 401/403 拦截 (JWT Auth Latency & Rejections)
06 · GCP Cloud Run 运行的服务 (Project: xworktech, Services: accounts, content, billing)
Cloud Run 请求速率与响应延迟 (Request Rate & Latency p95)

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (rate(cloud_run_request_count{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"}[1m])) or sum by (service_name) (rate(run_googleapis_com_request_count{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"}[1m]))

panels.title: 容器实例伸缩与冷启动次数 (Active Instances & Cold Starts)

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (cloud_run_container_instance_count{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"}) or sum by (service_name) (run_googleapis_com_container_instance_count{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"})

panels.title: Cloud Run CPU 与内存资源利用率 (CPU & Memory Utilization %)

targets.expr: avg by (service_name) (cloud_run_container_cpu_utilizations{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"} * 100) or avg by (service_name) (run_googleapis_com_container_cpu_utilizations{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"} * 100)

avg by (service_name) (cloud_run_container_memory_utilizations{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"} * 100) or avg by (service_name) (run_googleapis_com_container_memory_utilizations{env=~"$env", service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"} * 100)

panels.title: 07 · ★ Supabase Cloud DB / PostgreSQL 深度性能与连接池 (重点关注核心数据库 - Project: iqkxspmhcfqmhkbjdoms)
Postgres 客户端连接数与 Supavisor 连接池负载 (Active Connections vs Max Limit)
每秒事务吞吐量 (Transactions Per Second - Commits vs Rollbacks)
共享内存缓存命中率 (Shared Buffer Cache & Index Hit Ratio %)

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{env=~"$env", datname=~"$database"}[5m])) / (sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{env=~"$env", datname=~"$database"}[5m])) + sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{env=~"$env", datname=~"$database"}[5m]))) * 100

panels.title: SQL 查询耗时分位数 (Query Duration Percentiles - p50, p95, p99)
死元组膨胀与自动清理 (Dead Tuples Bloat & Autovacuum Activity)
数据库存储容量与 WAL 日志生成速率 (DB Storage & WAL Rate)
08 · 全栈统一日志流下钻 (VictoriaLogs: Cloudflare, Cloud Run, Supabase DB)
组件错误与告警分布 (Errors & Warnings by Component)

targets.expr: i(error) env:~"$env" | stats by (source_type, service_name) count() error_count | sort by (error_count desc) | limit 12

panels.title: ★ Supabase PostgreSQL 慢查询与错误日志 (DB Slow Queries & Errors)

targets.expr: (source_type:"supabase" or source_type:"postgres") (i(error) or i(duration) or i(fatal)) env:~"$env" | sort by (_time desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Cloud Run 与 Cloudflare Edge 运行时日志 (Cloud Run & Worker Logs)

targets.expr: (source_type:"cloud_run" or source_type:"cloudflare") env:~"$env" | sort by (_time desc) | limit 50
